summary:
Ilya Rozanov wakes up from a medically induced coma, sixteen months into a mission to save the dying sun, and he can't remember a single one of his crewmates.
He's immediately drawn to one of them, though. Too bad Hollander won't give him the time of day.
bookmark_notes: Love! Just wish there was an epilogue to help pacing at the end, almost like aftercare lmao, got a massive emotional spike at the end and feel like I need a little more time in the universe to come down from the last high. Also I love a good reveal (read: hunter and roses reactions), and for an epilogue of them on earth finally doing the tell-all that Yuna was thinking of
